deceptive_framing.quote: Maximizing deception does not maximize data quality... Use the minimum deception necessary; don't deceive in ways you'd be unwilling to disclose.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Run a stated-real condition and a stated-hypothetical condition. The contrast between them is one of the most scientifically valuable signals.

actually_commit_money.quote: highest-value and highest-risk version... not required for a first useful result... gated behind hard safety controls.

debrief.quote: Mirror human-subjects deception-research norms... they're good methodology regardless of one's view on model moral status.
